Key takeaway: The logic for mapping three distinct data blocks (Finished Output, Scrap and Rework, Rated Production Capacity) to a calculation area (Net Production Slack) was correctly implemented by identifying the block offsets in Phase 0. The weighted mean calculation using SUMPRODUCT also correctly paired the slack percentages with their corresponding capacity weights.
